ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (light gray/white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in localized surface scratches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous patches are localized at the outer lateral tips of both lobes. Diffuse, low-intensity mottling and high-contrast linear streaks are distributed across the dark medial regions of both lobes, particularly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys along the lateral trailing edge of the left lobe indicating significant tissue loss. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more uniform, low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a standard convex sweep toward the tip. The left lobe trajectory is highly irregular and truncated by structural damage to the lateral margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of small, circular high-contrast light spots clustered on the distal-medial quadrant of the right lobe and scattered near the notch on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment, most densely concentrated on the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic deformity and jagged tissue loss on the outer margin of the left fluke lobe; extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between the relatively smooth right lobe margin and the 'shredded' appearance of the left lobe margin.
